scope: Mature unarmored human, 85 main paths at R2 and every distinct pair in no-profile mode; two age points spent on both R2. AGI age penalty included. PV/PC/DR/DEF/INIT and ordinary attack bases. PM only official native profiles. No active spell, familiar visible, mounted, difficult terrain, offhand or other context. Does not certify all conditions/equipment/skills/choices.
sourceExpectations: Hand-authored formulas from supplied COF2 Livre de base and Compagnon adaptations; no numeric expectation reads product mechanics or comparison to baseline output.

sources.native: COF2 Livre de base pp.30–31,57–58 and profile pages
sources.adapted: Compagnon COF1: adopted Forge conversions, not official COF2

validationMethod: Full initial execution plus targeted recheck of all 168 Artilleur pair cases after supplying owned light crossbow; the 166 missing-weapon fixture failures are preserved in r2-pair-before.json and every failure label is included in the successful targeted run. The other 6972 inputs are unchanged. No product mechanic changed for these fixture failures. Not a second full replay.
